title: "binary trait in AoU with different effective sample size"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# read common models #
aou_report <- read_csv(file.path("../result", "ensembleprs", "aou_ensembleprs_overall_overlaptraits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
breaks_round <- c(-Inf, 1000, 2000, 3500, 6000, Inf)
aou_result <- aou_report %>% mutate(case_bin = as.integer(cut(ensemble_case_num, breaks = breaks_round, right = FALSE)))

# iterate all case bins #
output_dir <- file.path("../result", "spectral_ranking", "temp_file")
for (bin in unique(aou_result$case_bin)) {
  temp_result <- aou_result %>% filter(case_bin == bin)

  # save matrix #
  # Method order here must match the order of auc_list below
  # Idx = c("glm", "superlearner", "tabpfn", "autogluon", "unsemble", "single", "all_prs")
  Idx <- c("glm", "superlearner", "tabpfn", "autogluon", "best_all_single", "all_prs")
  numidx <- length(Idx)
  xx <- matrix(0, 0, numidx)
  ww <- matrix(0, 0, numidx)
  count <- 0

  for (i in 1:nrow(temp_result)) {
    target_row <- temp_result[i, ]

    # AUCs in the same order as Idx (all-PRS GLM ensemble added as the last method)
    auc_list <- c(
      target_row$glm,
      target_row$superlearner,
      target_row$tabpfn,
      target_row$autogluon,
      # target_row$unsemble,
      target_row$best_all_single,
      target_row$all_prs
    )

    # Skip traits with any missing AUC (including missing all-PRS AUC)
    if (any(is.na(auc_list))) next
    count <- count + 1

    # Pairwise comparisons: each pair contributes one row to AA (pair indicator) and WW (winner indicator)
    for (j in 1:(length(auc_list) - 1)) {
      for (k in (j + 1):length(auc_list)) {
        tmp.xx <- numeric(numidx)
        tmp.ww <- numeric(numidx)

        if (auc_list[j] > auc_list[k]) {
          tmp.v1 <- Idx[k]
          tmp.v2 <- Idx[j]
        } else {
          tmp.v2 <- Idx[k]
          tmp.v1 <- Idx[j]
        }

        tmp.xx[Idx == tmp.v1] <- 1
        tmp.xx[Idx == tmp.v2] <- 1
        tmp.ww[Idx == tmp.v2] <- 1

        xx <- rbind(xx, tmp.xx)
        ww <- rbind(ww, tmp.ww)
      }
    }
  }
  cat("Bin: ", bin, "Num of traits: ", count, "\n")
  yy <- matrix(c(xx), ncol = numidx)
  zz <- matrix(c(ww), ncol = numidx)
  write.table(yy, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_AA_", bin)))
  write.table(Idx, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_method_", bin)))
  write.table(zz, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_WW_", bin)))
}
```

```{r}
# calculate ranking result #
all_bins_df <- data.frame()

for (bin in unique(aou_result$case_bin)) {
  AA0 <- read.table(file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_AA_", bin)))
  AA2 <- as.matrix(AA0)
  IdxJournal <- read.table(file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_method_", bin)))
  WW0 <- read.table(file.path(output_dir, paste0("aou_binary_ranking_WW_", bin)))
  WW2 <- as.matrix(WW0)

  B <- 2000
  n <- ncol(AA2)
  L2 <- nrow(AA2)
  fAvec2 <- numeric(L2) + 2 ## weight for vanilla spectral method ##

  dval2 <- 2 * max(colSums(AA2)) ## value of d ##
  P2 <- matrix(0, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (j != i) {
        P2[i, j] <- sum(AA2[, i] * AA2[, j] * WW2[, j] / fAvec2) / dval2
      }
    }
    P2[i, i] <- 1 - sum(P2[i, ])
  }

  tmp.P2 <- t(t(P2) - diag(n)) %*% (t(P2) - diag(n))
  tmp.svd2 <- svd(tmp.P2)
  pihat2 <- abs(tmp.svd2$v[, n])
  thetahat2 <- log(pihat2) - mean(log(pihat2))

  RR2 <- matrix(0, 6, n)
  # colnames(RR2) <- c("GLM", "Superlearner", "TabPFN", "Autogluon", "UNSemblePRS", "BestSingle")
  colnames(RR2) <- c("GLM", "Superlearner", "TabPFN", "Autogluon", "BestSingle", "AllPRS")
  RR2[1, ] <- thetahat2
  RR2[2, ] <- n + 1 - rank(thetahat2)

  Vmatrix2 <- matrix(0, L2, n)
  tauhatvec2 <- numeric(n)
  tmp.pimatrix2 <- t(AA2) * pihat2
  tmp.pivec2 <- colSums(tmp.pimatrix2)
  tmp.var2 <- numeric(n)
  for (oo in 1:n) {
    tauhatvec2[oo] <- sum(AA2[, oo] * (1 - pihat2[oo] / tmp.pivec2) * pihat2[oo] / fAvec2, na.rm = TRUE) / dval2
    tmp.var2[oo] <- sum(AA2[, oo] * (tmp.pivec2 - pihat2[oo]) / fAvec2 / fAvec2) * pihat2[oo] / dval2 / dval2 / tauhatvec2[oo] / tauhatvec2[oo]
    Vmatrix2[, oo] <- (AA2[, oo] * WW2[, oo] * tmp.pivec2 - AA2[, oo] * pihat2[oo]) / fAvec2
  }
  sigmahatmatrix2 <- matrix(tmp.var2, n, n) + t(matrix(tmp.var2, n, n))

  Wmatrix2 <- matrix(rnorm(L2 * B), L2, B)
  tmp.Vtau2 <- (t(Vmatrix2) / tauhatvec2) %*% Wmatrix2

  R.left.m2 <- numeric(n)
  R.right.m2 <- numeric(n)
  R.left.one.m2 <- numeric(n)

  for (ooo in 1:n) {
    tmpGMmatrix02 <- matrix(rep(tmp.Vtau2[ooo, ], n) - c(t(tmp.Vtau2)), B, n)
    tmpGMmatrix2 <- abs(t(t(tmpGMmatrix02) / sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[ooo, ])) / dval2)
    tmpGMmatrixone2 <- t(t(tmpGMmatrix02) / sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[ooo, ])) / dval2
    tmp.GMvecmax2 <- apply(tmpGMmatrix2, 1, max)
    tmp.GMvecmaxone2 <- apply(tmpGMmatrixone2, 1, max)
    cutval2 <- quantile(tmp.GMvecmax2, 0.95)
    cutvalone2 <- quantile(tmp.GMvecmaxone2, 0.95)
    tmp.theta.sd2 <- sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[ooo, ])
    tmp.theta.sd2 <- tmp.theta.sd2[-ooo]
    R.left.m2[ooo] <- 1 + sum(1 * (((thetahat2[-ooo] - thetahat2[ooo]) / tmp.theta.sd2) > cutval2))
    R.right.m2[ooo] <- n - sum(1 * (((thetahat2[-ooo] - thetahat2[ooo]) / tmp.theta.sd2) < (-cutval2)))
    R.left.one.m2[ooo] <- 1 + sum(1 * (((thetahat2[-ooo] - thetahat2[ooo]) / tmp.theta.sd2) > cutvalone2))
  }

  RR2[3, ] <- R.left.m2
  RR2[4, ] <- R.right.m2
  RR2[5, ] <- R.left.one.m2

  Wmatrix2 <- matrix(rnorm(L2 * B), L2, B)
  tmp.Vtau2 <- (t(Vmatrix2) / tauhatvec2) %*% Wmatrix2
  Mval <- n
  GMvecmax2 <- numeric(B) - 1
  GMvecmaxone2 <- numeric(B) - Inf
  tmpTMval2 <- -1
  tmpTMvalone2 <- -Inf

  for (ooo in 1:n) {
    tmpGMmatrix02 <- matrix(rep(tmp.Vtau2[ooo, ], n) - c(t(tmp.Vtau2)), B, n)
    tmpGMmatrix2 <- abs(t(t(tmpGMmatrix02) / sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[ooo, ])) / dval2)
    tmpGMmatrixone2 <- t(t(tmpGMmatrix02) / sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[ooo, ])) / dval2
    tmp.GMvecmax2 <- apply(tmpGMmatrix2, 1, max)
    tmp.GMvecmaxone2 <- apply(tmpGMmatrixone2, 1, max)
    GMvecmax2 <- c(GMvecmax2, tmp.GMvecmax2)
    GMvecmaxone2 <- c(GMvecmaxone2, tmp.GMvecmaxone2)
  }

  GMmaxmatrixone2 <- matrix(GMvecmaxone2, B)
  GMmaxone2 <- apply(GMmaxmatrixone2, 1, max)
  cutvalone2 <- quantile(GMmaxone2, 0.95)

  R.left.one2 <- numeric(n)
  for (oooo in 1:n) {
    tmp.theta.sd2 <- sqrt(sigmahatmatrix2[oooo, ])
    tmp.theta.sd2 <- tmp.theta.sd2[-oooo]
    R.left.one2[oooo] <- 1 + sum(1 * (((thetahat2[-oooo] - thetahat2[oooo]) / tmp.theta.sd2) > cutvalone2))
  }
  RR2[6, ] <- R.left.one2 ## uniform left-sided CI for rank ##
  cat("Bin = ", bin, "\n")
  print(RR2)

  # append result for this case bin #
  methods <- colnames(RR2)
  rank <- RR2[2, ]
  lower <- RR2[3, ]
  upper <- RR2[4, ]

  df <- data.frame(
    method = methods,
    rank = as.numeric(rank),
    lower = as.numeric(lower),
    upper = as.numeric(upper),
    bin = bin
  )
  all_bins_df <- bind_rows(all_bins_df, df)
}

result_path <- file.path("../result", "spectral_ranking", "aou_5bin.csv")
write.csv(all_bins_df, file = result_path, row.names = FALSE)
```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
